name: comp-549
title: Multi File Upload List
description: A tall uploader: a dashed drop box at the top and one bordered row per file below, each with a type icon, filename, size and an X, with a Remove all button under the list.
use: A form takes several documents of mixed types and each one must be removable on its own.
avoid: Rows show only name and size with no progress bar, so a slow upload gives no feedback.
a11y: Remove buttons are labelled and focusable, but the dashed drop area sits outside the tab order. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow column on black. The top is a dashed rounded box with a small file-up circle, "Upload files", a browse line and a dim limits line. Below sit short bordered rows with a square icon tile, a name over its size, and a faint x, ending in an outlined Remove all files button.
behaves: Dropping or clicking fills the list row by row from three to six files; each x drops its own row and Remove all clears everything. Dragging over the drop box tints it, and oversize or extra files raise a red warning.
customise: The ten-file cap, the 100MB ceiling and three seed files are written in the file; the file-type icons and row layout are source edits as well.
weight: light: A handful of seed rows and a hidden file input; no animation loop.
